documents.text: A young fox carried a blue cup to the river.
The baker put warm bread on a clean plate.
Mia found a tiny bell under the old chair.
Rain fell on the quiet road beside the farm.
A little dog watched the boat leave the lake.
Sam planted a seed and gave it fresh water.
The red bird sang while the children walked home.
Nora opened a book about stars after dinner.
